title: Lanterns in the Breeze
description: Follow evening light from the meadow into woodland dusk, through lantern gardens, and out beneath a deep-blue sky.

signs.text:
The late-afternoon meadow
Hop through the last warm sunlight

The sunset path
Cross the sun-warmed garden stones

The dusk woodland edge
Keep below the darkening branches

The lantern gardens
Climb through the lit porticoes

Under the deep-blue sky
The final garden terrace opens to the stars
